NOTICE
BTech/ BCA Honours with Research
Eligibility and Cuidelines
AlL concerned students of the B.Tech and BCA programmes are hereby informed about the
provision for Honours with Research.
As per the BTech and BCA programme curriculum, completing a Project is a mandatory
requirement for all students
As recommended in the Departmental Council
Meeting held on Sth August 2026 , students
fulfilling the prescribed academic criteria may be given an opportunity to Opt for B.Tech/BCA
Honours with Research
as
applicable.
Eligibility and Requirements
Students who have secured an average GPA of 7.5 or above Up to the end of the Third Year
(Semester I to Semester VI) may be given an opportunity to opt for BTech/BCA Honours
with Research. Eligible students may earn 4 additional credits by carrying Out research work
and successfully publishing at least one research paper in an indexed conference Or journal
during the entire Fourth  Year. Eligible students whose research
papers are accepted
or
published based on their research work may be considered for the award of B.Tech/BCA
Honours with Research
as
applicable
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
1: Is the Project compulsory for every B.Tech/BCA student?
Yes: As per the curriculum; the Project is a mandatory component of the BTech and BCA
degree programmes_
2. Who is eligible to opt for Honours with Research?
Students
an average GPA of 7.5 0r above Up to the end of Semester VI may be
considered eligible to opt for BTech/BCA
Honours with
Research; subject to
applicable
academic rules_
3. Is Honours with Research compulsory for eligible students?
No.  It is
an
additional  academic  opportunity for  eligible students:
The
regular  Project
requirement remains mandatory for all students
4. How many additional credits can be earned?
An eligible student may earn
additional credits through the prescribed research work for
Honours with Research_
5. Is publication of a research paper compulsory?
For consideration for Honours with Research , the student is required to have at least one
research paper accepted or published in an indexed conference Or journal , subject t0 the
applicable academic requirements_
6. Is acceptance of the paper sufficient; Or must it already be published?
A research paper that is accepted or published, subject to verification and applicable academic
requirements, may be considered.
7. Can any research paper be used for Honours with Research?
The paper should be based on the research work carried out by the student as part of the
programme and should satisfy the prescribed academic and publication requirements_
8. Can a paper
'published before the Fourth Year be considered?
The requirement specifically relates to research work undertaken for Honours with Research
the prescribed programme period. Eligibility of any earlier work will be subject to
verification and approval by the DepartmentUniversity as per applicable rules_
9_
Does having
a
GPA of 7.5 or above automatically give
a
student  Honours with
Research?
No: A GPA of 7.5 or above provides eligibility to be considered for Opting for Honours with
Research
The final award depends on successful completion of all prescribed requirements
such as research
publication.
